class.name: CanvasItem
class.brief_description: Base class for nodes drawn on a 2D canvas.
class.description: Controls inherit this class. An item can be hidden by its own visibility setting or by a parent item.

method.name: SetVisible
method.description: Sets the visibility of this item. Hiding it also cancels interface interaction with it. Does nothing if the visibility value has not changed.
method.param: True to show the item, or false to hide it. A hidden parent item can still hide this item.
True to also cancel a drag tied to this item when hiding it. Focus, hover, and pointer capture are cleared either way.

method.name: IsVisible
method.description: Gets this item's own visibility setting. Does not check whether a parent item is hidden.
method.returns: True if this item is set to be visible.
